[[File:SR-race-Nord.jpg|thumb|left|A compilation of the preset Nord faces available in Skyrim]][[File:SR-concept-6877541105.jpg|right|thumb|Female concept art]][[File:SR-concept-6877541355.jpg|right|thumb|Male concept art]]
The '''Nords''' are the children of the sky, a race of tall and fair-haired humans from [[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]] who are known for their incredible resistance to cold and magical frost. They are fierce, strong and enthusiastic warriors, and many become renowned warriors, soldiers and mercenaries all over [[Lore:Tamriel|Tamriel]]. Eager to augment their martial skills beyond the traditional methods of Skyrim, they excel in all manner of warfare, and are known as a militant people by their neighbors. Nords were known for a time for their nautical prowess when they migrated from [[Lore:Atmora|Atmora]]. {{FMI}}

Nords are the most common race encountered in Skyrim's  cities, and can be encountered in nearly every aspect - among others, guards, merchants, bandits and Jarls.  [[Skyrim:Stormcloaks|Stormcloaks]] encountered consist almost entirely of Nords, with the Nords also making up the majority in the [[Skyrim:Imperial Legion|Imperial Legion]] as both officers and soldiers. A complete list can be found [[:Category:Skyrim-Nord|here]].
{{NewLeft}}

==In-Game Description==
''Citizens of Skyrim, they are a tall and fair-haired people. Strong and hardy, Nords are famous for their resistance to cold and their talent as warriors. They can use a Battlecry to make opponents flee.''

==Traits==
* ''{{Anchor|Resist Frost}}'' ability (FormID <code>000aa020</code>): Your Nord blood gives you 50% [[Skyrim:Resist Frost|resistance to Frost]], constant. 
* ''{{Anchor|Battle Cry}}'' greater power (FormID <code>000e40c3</code>): Targets flee for 30 seconds, once per day. 
** The power consists of the following effects:
*** ''Battle Cry'', 99 pts in 60 ft for 30 secs on Self
*** ''[[Skyrim:Stagger|Stagger Push]]'', 0.05 pts in 40 ft on Self
** Be warned that this power treats everyone in range as a target, and is considered an attack, so you may want to avoid using it in situations where you have non-follower allies or in the presence of civilians.
** Despite its similarity to the [[Skyrim:Illusion|Illusion]] [[Skyrim:Fear (effect)|Fear]] effect, it does not benefit from any Illusion perks. It also does not affect undead, Daedra, or machines.
* [[Skyrim:Fortify Warmth|''{{Anchor|Fortify Warmth}}'']]{{CC|Survival Mode}} (FormID <code>xx00088b</code>): Your Nord blood improves your [[Skyrim:Warmth|resistance to cold environments]] by 25 points. 
* Height: 1.03.

==Skills==
* + 10 [[Skyrim:Two-handed|Two-Handed]]
* + 5 [[Skyrim:Block|Block]], [[Skyrim:Light Armor|Light Armor]], [[Skyrim:One-handed|One-handed]], [[Skyrim:Smithing|Smithing]], [[Skyrim:Speech|Speech]]

==Gameplay==
Nord skill bonuses lean toward a more combat-oriented style of play. With both one and two-handed weapons receiving boosts, players are able to choose their favorite weapon(s) with a bit more ease, and boosts to both light armor and blocking provides players both mobility and defense.

The Nord [[#Battle Cry|Battle Cry]] power can be vital at earlier levels, causing enemies to flee long enough for the player to potentially recover.

Their innate resistance to Frost provides them a significant advantage against foes such as the draugr, frost dragons, ice wraiths, and mages who employ Frost magic. If a Nord player decides to [[Skyrim:Vampirism|become a vampire]], they will reach the maximum frost resistance possible. (85%)
